lemma card_le_of_isSeparated {ε : ℝ≥0} {A C : Set X} (h_subset : C ⊆ A)
    (h_sep : IsSeparated ε C) (h : packingNumber ε A ≠ ⊤) :
    C.encard ≤ (maximalSeparatedSet ε A).encard := by
  rw [card_maximalSeparatedSet h]
  exact le_iSup_of_le C <| le_iSup_of_le h_subset <| le_iSup_of_le h_sep (by simp)

requested_change: Generalize the lemma statement by adding implicit binders `{ε : ℝ≥0} {A C : Set X}` to the lemma signature, keeping the proof unchanged.
